main_body: stone paving / brick floor terrain patch
evidence: This is a terrain ground/wall surface tile patch (4x3 tiles), which is exempt from standing object 3/4 top+front rules.

style.evidence: The stone blocks use 6 distinct warm grey-brown shading steps with top-edge highlights, varied block values, surface pockmarks, and dark warm-brown mortar seams, matching the Beodeul paving reference in craft and density.
